name: New Hampshire
summary: New Hampshire's law is signed and starts January 1, 2027: one system of up to 1,200 watts AC per meter, with no utility approval or fees. Until then, normal interconnection rules apply.
watt_cap_note: AC inverter output per metered customer, one system per meter.
certification: Building-code provisions wait on a nationally recognized standard (UL 3700) being certified by the Department of Energy.

utility.notification: Not established in the sources we found.
utility.fees: No utility approval or added fees.

renters: Not addressed in the sources we found. Ask your landlord in writing.
hoa: Not addressed in the sources we found.
notes: Devices must shut off automatically during a power outage.
open_questions: One source says parts of the act took effect on signing; most say January 1, 2027.
Signing date is reported as July 2 or July 3, 2026.
